objective: RANK 1 IS THE CONTROL THIS CAMPAIGN HAS OWED ITSELF SINCE BATCH-001, AND EVERY OPEN INTERPRETIVE QUESTION NOW SITS ON IT. After BATCH-007 proved Proposition 1 (W = 4 - |A| at r <= 4), the r <= 4 reading is a CERTAINTY rather than a measurement, and r >= 6 reads at the null across eleven arms. That leaves exactly one round count where anything is in question: r = 5, which reads 12-14 hits against an analytic 4 in 2^30. The campaign has never run an inventor-protocol section 3 NULL OBJECT for it. amask=15 is the |A|=4 case of the SAME formula, so it is another point of one deterministic family, not a null object; and a drawn-S-box arm is a POSITIVE control, because Proposition 1's H1 uses only bijectivity -- which is why BATCH-006's 27 random-S-box arms read a MEAN OF 15.48 rather than the null. THE OBJECT THAT HAS NEVER BEEN SUBSTITUTED IS THE CIPHER ITSELF. Replace the 5-round SPN with a random bijection on 128 bits and ask whether the yoyo statistic still reads elevated. If it does, the excess is a property of the PROBE GEOMETRY and five batches of yoyo readings measure the instrument rather than the cipher. If it does not, the excess is a property of the round structure and survives its first real control. RANK 2 is RC-11, the trial-index pairing that would let the matched r=5 and r=10 arms be analysed paired instead of unpaired, sharpening EV-AES-8b8dcf's OBS-B8-3 interval of [2.13, 592].
budget_note: Declared 5400 s producer, 900 s snapshot, 5400 s validation. GOAL-AES-003 wall-clock ceilings are null by protocol-amendment-GOAL-AES-003-002; max_concurrent stays 3 and is NOT relaxed by that amendment.
batch_notes: BINDING ON EVERY DOCUMENT IN THIS BATCH (DEC-20260803-f6f113): a batch objective, correction, review or decision may NOT assert that something was never measured unless that same document records the search performed -- the glob or grep executed, the number of files scanned, and the date. An unsearched absence claim is treated as an unrun measurement. The objective above asserts that no section 3 null object exists for the r=5 statistic; the producer's FIRST deliverable is to test that assertion by search and to report it false if it is false. Four absence-claim failures in two days (CORR-20260803-c92db5, -7d41c8, -4e91da, -8fa302) motivate this, three of them by the Coordinator, one of them made INSIDE the correction that prohibited them.

tasks.title: RANK 1: section 3 null object for the r=5 statistic; RANK 2: RC-11 trial-index pairing

handoff.objective: Substitute the cipher itself with a random bijection and ask whether the r=5 yoyo excess survives; then pair the matched arms by trial index.
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Whether the r=5 excess is a property of the five-round structure or of the probe geometry -- the campaign's central open question.
inputs: coordination/goals/GOAL-AES-003/batches/BATCH-008/tasks/TASK-20260803-05e072 (the v3 instrument, its source and diff)
constraints: DELIVERABLE ZERO, BEFORE ANY MEASUREMENT: TEST THIS BATCH'S OWN ABSENCE CLAIM. The objective asserts no section 3 null object exists for the r=5 statistic. SEARCH for one -- glob the run directories, grep for a random-permutation or random-function arm -- and write SEARCH_RECORD.md naming the globs run, the file count scanned and the date. If such an arm EXISTS, say so plainly and report the batch premise as false; that finding outranks everything else here. Four absence claims in this campaign have already proved false, three of them the Coordinator's.

RANK 1 CONSTRUCTION. The null object must substitute THE CIPHER, not a component. A random bijection on 128 bits cannot be stored, so use a keyed pseudorandom permutation the yoyo cannot exploit -- e.g. full 10-round AES under an independent key, or a wide-block construction -- in place of the 5-round reduced cipher, with the SAME probe geometry, SAME amask=1, SAME smask, SAME trial count and SAME seed discipline as the r=5 arm it controls. STATE IN THE PREREGISTRATION why your chosen surrogate is a fair null object and what would make it unfair. If you cannot construct a defensible one, SAY SO AND STOP -- a recorded inability to build the control is a legitimate and useful result, and is far better than a control that quietly is not one.

NOTE THE OBVIOUS OBJECTION AND ADDRESS IT: full 10-round AES is already measured in this campaign at r=10 and reads at the null, so using it risks being the arm the campaign already has. Explain what your construction adds beyond the existing r=10 arm, or explicitly ground rank 1 in that existing arm and spend the budget on rank 2 instead. Either is acceptable; pretending a rerun is a new control is not.

RANK 2 (RC-11). Log trial indices for the matched r=5 and r=10 arms so they can be analysed PAIRED. They already consume identical plaintext and swap streams by construction (same seed, armid, thread_seeds), so the pairing is real and only the logging is missing. Report the paired analysis and the interval it gives against the unpaired [2.13, 592].
IF YOU MODIFY THE INSTRUMENT, PROVE EQUIVALENCE AS BATCH-008 DID: additions only, ship the diff, rebuild, and reproduce an existing arm bit-exactly. That standard is now the campaign's floor.

C2 BUDGET CLOCK: first act writes budget_stamps.jsonl with start_utc, start_epoch, declared_wall_clock_seconds (5400) and the computed binding_stop_utc. Halt at the stop; HALTING IS FULL COMPLIANCE. List what you did not reach and what each would have settled.

PREREGISTER BEFORE MEASURING, stating what outcome falsifies and what confirms. THE OUTCOME THAT COSTS THIS CAMPAIGN THE MOST -- the null object reading elevated, meaning five batches of yoyo readings measure the probe -- MUST BE REPORTED IN THE FIRST LINE OF RESULTS.json IF IT OCCURS.
INFERENCE BLOCK on every structured artifact: policy, requested_policy, actual resolved model, fallback_used, model_verified false, standing basis 0137a051eb5828789eb267fa83c8278086578d4c.
TOY TIER. No full-round or deployed-AES claim; no comparison to published cryptanalysis in either direction.
EVERY STRUCTURED ARTIFACT MUST PARSE -- parse the WHOLE file before finishing and say inside it that you did.
DO NOT COMMIT and do not run git add. Write only inside your write_scope; never to the repository root.
Assign no hypothesis status, no evidence strength, recommend no promotion.
A timeout, crash or OOM is INFRASTRUCTURE and is never negative mathematical evidence.

A defensible section 3 null object for the r=5 statistic, or a recorded argument that none can be built within budget and why.
The null-object reading against the r=5 arm it controls, with exact intervals.
